banner_offline_body: Auto-fill needs a connection. Fill in the car yourself.
banner_disabled_body: You fill in the car yourself. You can switch auto-fill on in Profile.
banner_not_configured_body: The AI is not configured on the server. Fill in the car yourself.
banner_quota_body: Auto-fill works 15 times a day. Fill in the car yourself.
banner_busy_body: Too many requests right now. Fill in the car yourself or try again later.
banner_timeout_body: No answer within 35 seconds. Fill in the car yourself.
banner_error_body: Something went wrong. Fill in the car yourself.
banner_unsupported_body: This device cannot prepare the photo for auto-fill. Fill in the car yourself.
consent_body: Auto-fill sends a small copy of this photo (max 768 px, without location data) to Cloudflare Workers AI to recognise the car and find the plates. Nothing is stored there, and Redline never stores the AI answer or the plate text.
consent_point_blur: You still blur the plates yourself, on your phone.
consent_point_switch: Switch it off at any time in Profile.
